story.label: HOW I THINK UNDER PRESSURE
story.heading: Real systems revealed
story.copy: Find the true state, place the logic carefully, and make the outcome reviewable. That is how I turn complexity into a useful next action.

experienceSection.label: WHERE IT GOT REAL
experienceSection.heading: Then the stakes
experienceSection.copy: Production systems brought latency, scale, messy data, and people depending on the outcome. That is where my work moved from building features to engineering decisions.

timeline.title: Find the real state.
timeline.body: Identify the event, source of truth, and constraints first. Reliable decisions need reliable context.

timeline.title: Choose where logic belongs.
timeline.body: Use rules where certainty exists and AI where interpretation helps. The boundary between them is part of the product design.

timeline.title: Make the outcome reviewable.
timeline.body: Show enough evidence, feedback, and recovery paths for a person to understand the result and act with confidence.

principles: A polished response is worthless if the system cannot show how it reached the next action.
When people work in real time, waiting and stale state are interface problems—not only infrastructure problems.
AI may suggest, classify, or summarize. The product must preserve review, boundaries, and a traceable decision.
